tagline: A clearer view of your land
title: Grounded in precision.
intro: A professional workspace for surveying, measuring and organizing land information.
description: The drawing workspace supports local project copies. Map imagery and automatic saving are not yet available.
principle1Body: Clear measurements and dependable workflows are at the heart of the platform.
principle2Body: Local-first tools are planned so basic work can remain accessible without an account.
principle3Body: English and বাংলা are supported from the start, with room to grow.
footer: Thoughtfully built for the land professionals of tomorrow.
notFoundBody: The page you requested does not exist.
guestDescription: You are using Land Expert without an account. Save copies locally; changes are not saved automatically.
languageSettingsDescription: Choose the language used throughout the workspace. Changes apply immediately.
reportLanguageNote: Report language is independent of the interface language; Bengali PDF support is not yet available.
guestSettingsDescription: No account is required. Project copies are stored in this browser; changes are not saved automatically.
languageStorageWarning: Your language changed for this session, but it could not be saved on this device.
surveyIntro: Explore geographic drawing and measurement in a temporary session.
noBasemapDescription: The default grid is not imagery. Optional online map data may be incomplete or inaccurate; verify boundaries independently.
unsavedDescription: Save a local copy below. Changes in the editor are lost when you leave or refresh.
mapError: The drawing map could not be loaded. Try refreshing or using a browser with WebGL support.
mapHelp: Choose a tool and click or tap the map. Close a polygon at its first point. Finish a line with Enter or by tapping its last point again. Select a shape to edit: drag a vertex, click or tap a midpoint to add one, or right-click a vertex to remove it. Touch vertex removal is not yet supported.
coordinatesHint: Move over the map for coordinates
measurementHint: Select a completed geometry to see its measurements.
selectFeatureHint: No geometry selected. Draw or select a feature on the map.
measurementMethod: Turf spherical approximation on WGS84 longitude/latitude; results are estimates, not cadastral or legal survey measurements. Antimeridian crossings and polygon holes are not supported.
geometry_incomplete: Geometry is incomplete or has zero area.
geometry_selfIntersection: The polygon intersects itself. Edit it before relying on measurements.
leaveSurveyConfirm: Changes in the editor may not be saved. Leave this page?
projectsDescription: Save a named copy of completed, valid geometry on this device. Copies are stored in this browser only.
projectsUnavailable: Local projects could not be opened. Browser storage may be blocked, unavailable, or contain unsupported data. No data was removed.
saveCopyHint: Saving creates a new copy; it does not automatically update an existing project. Up to 100 features, with at most 2,000 vertices each.
projectInvalid: Enter a name and check that all geometries are valid and within the supported limits.
projectSaved: Project copy saved on this device.
projectSaveError: Could not save the project. Existing projects were not changed.
projectOpened: Project opened in the editor. Changes are not saved automatically.
projectStaleError: This copy changed or was removed in another tab. Refresh saved copies and try again.
projectOpenError: Could not open this project. The saved copy was not changed.
projectDeleteError: Delete failed. The copy may have changed or been removed in another tab; refresh the list and try again.
openEmptyHint: Open a project only in an empty drawing workspace. Leave and return to clear the current session.
deleteProjectConfirm: Permanently delete the saved copy “{{name}}” from this browser?
backupHint: Backups include saved copies only, not unsaved editor changes. Files are unencrypted: store them securely, keep a separate copy and test recovery. All-copy backups support up to 100 projects and 10 MiB; each individual backup also has a 10 MiB limit. Restore rejects existing IDs and never overwrites them.
backupError: Could not prepare the backup. It may exceed the 100-project or 10 MiB limit, or storage may be unavailable.
geojsonError: Could not prepare GeoJSON for this project.
restoreConfirm_one: Restore {{count}} project? Existing projects will not be replaced.
restoreConfirm_other: Restore {{count}} projects? Existing projects will not be replaced.
restoreError: Restore failed. The file may be invalid, exceed the limits, or contain IDs already in this browser. No projects were added.
restoreRefreshError: Restore completed, but the list could not be refreshed. Reload to view your projects.
geojsonImportHint: Files must be valid UTF-8. Import a 2D RFC 7946 FeatureCollection in WGS84 longitude/latitude (max 10 MiB, 100 features). Points, lines and single-ring polygons only. Explicit CRS declarations are rejected; no reprojection is performed. Verify the source CRS yourself: coordinates alone cannot prove it. Imported IDs and other properties are not preserved.
geojsonCrsConfirm: I verified this file uses WGS84 longitude and latitude. The app cannot verify the source CRS.
geojsonImportSuccess: GeoJSON imported as a new local project copy. Open it from an empty drawing workspace.
geojsonImportError: Import failed. Check the name, file size, WGS84 coordinates, supported geometry and validity. Existing projects were not changed.
projectActionError: Could not complete the action. The project may have changed in another tab; reload and try again.
reportHint: English PDF is available for projects with English ASCII names and up to 5,000 coordinates. Bengali PDF is unavailable while a Unicode extraction issue is investigated. Diagrams are schematic and measurements are estimates.
reportError: Could not generate the PDF. Only English reports with ASCII project names and up to 5,000 coordinates are supported; check your device and try again.
projectsRefreshed: Saved copies refreshed from this browser.
projectsRefreshError: Could not refresh saved copies. Your stored data was not changed.
previewNotice: Not for legal or cadastral decisions. Local data may be lost; keep and verify separate backups. Optional cloud backups require an account and explicit upload. Bengali PDF is not available.
singleBackupError: Could not prepare this copy’s backup. The copy may be unavailable or exceed 10 MiB.
backupCheckHint: Files must be valid UTF-8. Checks file format, size and project data without restoring, then checks this browser for existing IDs. Data may change before restore; this does not prove authenticity or detect every alteration.
backupCheckError: Backup check failed. The file may be invalid, unreadable or over the size limit. No data was restored.
backupCheckSuccess_one: Backup format and project data validated ({{count}} saved copy). No data was restored.
backupCheckSuccess_other: Backup format and project data validated ({{count}} saved copies). No data was restored.
backupNoConflicts: No matching IDs were found at the time of checking. A later restore can still fail.
backupConflicts_one: {{count}} project ID already exists here. Restore will reject the entire backup unless conflicts are resolved.
backupConflicts_other: {{count}} project IDs already exist here. Restore will reject the entire backup unless conflicts are resolved.
backupConflictUnavailable: Could not check existing project IDs; restore may fail. No data was restored.
invalidStoredProjects_one: {{count}} stored record could not be read and was not changed. All-copy backup is disabled to avoid omitting it; back up readable copies individually. Refresh after resolving storage problems. Do not clear browser data.
invalidStoredProjects_other: {{count}} stored records could not be read and were not changed. All-copy backup is disabled to avoid omitting them; back up readable copies individually. Refresh after resolving storage problems. Do not clear browser data.
noReadableProjects: No readable saved project copies are currently available.
diagnosticHint: Diagnostic only—not a restorable backup. Contains unencrypted raw data; store securely. Limited to 100 records and 10 MiB; unsupported data types cannot be exported. Do not clear browser data.
diagnosticError: Diagnostic export failed or no unreadable records remain. Data may exceed limits or contain unsupported types. Nothing was changed; do not clear browser data.
basemapPrivacy: The grid sends no tile requests, but the app itself must already be loaded; offline app use is not guaranteed. Selecting an online map sends the viewed area and your IP address to its tile provider. Internet is required; no offline tile downloads. The community OpenStreetMap service is experimental and not approved for production use.
basemapError: Map tiles could not be loaded. Your drawing remains available; select Offline grid or check your connection.
catalogError: Online map catalog could not be loaded or is invalid. The offline grid and drawing remain available.
gpsPrivacy: Location is requested only when you press the button. Your browser may ask for permission. The one-time result stays in this page until cleared or closed; it is not saved to projects or sent by this app. Online basemap providers can infer areas you view. GPS accuracy varies and is not a legal survey.
gpsPending: Waiting for your browser and device…
gpsStale: This position is over 60 seconds old. Request a new location before centering.
gpsOutsideMap: This latitude is outside the map projection; centering is unavailable.
gpsError_unsupported: Location is unavailable in this browser or context.
gpsError_denied: Location permission was denied. Check your browser or device settings.
gpsError_unavailable: The device could not determine a location.
gpsError_timeout: Location request timed out. Try again with a clearer signal.
gpsError_invalid: The device returned an invalid location; no position was used.
georefHint: Place a north-up PNG or JPEG using its known WGS84 longitude/latitude bounds (decimal degrees, dot as decimal separator). This stretches the image into a rectangle; it does not calculate control points or fix rotation/distortion. Maximum 8 MiB and 16 million pixels. The image and alignment exist only in this session: they are not saved in projects, backups or PDFs. Do not use this estimate as a legal boundary.
georefMessage_invalid: Invalid bounds or image type/size. Use ordered WGS84 bounds and a supported image.
georefMessage_failed: Could not place the image. Check its format, dimensions and map availability; any previous reference is retained when possible.
georefMessage_success: Reference image placed. It is temporary and is not saved with the project.
georefFinishDrawing: Finish or cancel the current drawing before placing an image.
georefMessage_drawing: The image was not placed because a drawing started while it loaded. Finish or cancel that drawing and try again.
cloudPrivacy: Optional: signing in connects to the configured cloud service. Uploading sends your saved local projects and coordinates to that service; cloud backups are not end-to-end encrypted. Unsaved drawings and temporary reference images are excluded. Review the provider’s privacy and retention policies before uploading.
cloudNotConfigured: Cloud is not configured for this deployment. Local projects continue to work; an administrator must configure a suitable Supabase project.
cloudSessionHint: The session is kept in memory only and is lost on reload. Email confirmation may be required. Password recovery is not available in this preview.
cloudSignupCheckEmail: If registration is available, check your email for a confirmation link, then sign in.
cloudAuthError: Could not complete account action. Check your details, connection and service settings.
cloudSignoutError: Could not sign out. Try again.
cloudSnapshotHint: Manual snapshots only: no automatic sync or overwrite. Refresh to list up to 50 recent backups. Restoring rejects any ID already on this device; refresh the saved-project list after restore. No unreadable records may be omitted.
cloudUploadConfirm: Upload all saved, readable local project copies to your cloud account? They are not end-to-end encrypted. Unsaved drawings and reference images are excluded.
cloudUploadSuccess: Backup uploaded. Refresh the cloud list to see it. Keep separate verified backups.
cloudUploadError: Could not upload. Check the connection, local storage, unreadable records and the 100-project / 10 MiB limit. Nothing was deleted locally.
cloudListError: Could not load cloud backups. Check the connection and account.
cloudRestoreConfirm: Restore {{count}} saved copies from this cloud backup to this browser? Existing project IDs will cause the whole restore to fail.
cloudRestoreSuccess: Cloud backup restored locally. Refresh saved copies in the survey workspace.
cloudRestoreError: Restore failed: the backup may be invalid, inaccessible, too large, or contain existing IDs. No local copies were overwritten.
cloudDeleteConfirm: Permanently delete this cloud backup? Local projects and other backups will not be deleted.
cloudDeleteError: Could not delete this cloud backup; refresh and try again.
tenantDescription: Create and rename organizations you belong to. This preview does not move your local survey projects into an organization.
tenantLoadError: Could not load organizations. Check the connection and account.
tenantOperationError: Could not complete the organization change. Check your access and connection.
tenantEmpty: You do not belong to an organization yet.
tenantCreated: Organization created. You are its owner.
tenantPlanNotice: Plans, billing and quota enforcement are not configured; license status is informational only.
cloudSignupDesktopHint: Create the account in the web app first; desktop sign-up confirmation links are not configured in this preview.
cloudSignupMobileHint: Create the account in the web app first; Android sign-up confirmation links are not configured yet.
